import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/coffee_sales.csv')

# Convert date and time to datetime
df['datetime'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'] + ' ' + df['time'])
df['hour'] = df['datetime'].dt.hour
df['day_of_week'] = df['datetime'].dt.day_name()

# Set style
plt.style.use('seaborn-v0_8-darkgrid')
sns.set_palette("husl")

# Create figure with subplots
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(18, 12))

# 1. Sales by product category (top left)
ax1 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 1)
product_sales = df.groupby('product')['total'].sum().sort_values(ascending=False)
bars = ax1.bar(range(len(product_sales)), product_sales.values, color=plt.cm.Set3(np.arange(len(product_sales))/len(product_sales)))
ax1.set_xticks(range(len(product_sales)))
ax1.set_xticklabels(product_sales.index, rotation=45, ha='right')
ax1.set_xlabel('Product')
ax1.set_ylabel('Total Sales ($)')
ax1.set_title('Total Sales by Product', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax1.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# 2. Sales by hour of day (top middle)
ax2 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 2)
hourly_sales = df.groupby('hour')['total'].sum()
ax2.plot(hourly_sales.index, hourly_sales.values, marker='o', linewidth=2.5, markersize=8)
ax2.fill_between(hourly_sales.index, hourly_sales.values, alpha=0.3)
ax2.set_xlabel('Hour of Day')
ax2.set_ylabel('Total Sales ($)')
ax2.set_title('Sales by Hour of Day', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_xticks(range(0, 24, 2))
ax2.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# 3. Sales by age group (top right)
ax3 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 3)
age_order = ['18-24', '25-34', '35-44', '45-54', '55+']
age_sales = df.groupby('customer_age_group')['total'].sum().reindex(age_order)
wedges, texts, autotexts = ax3.pie(age_sales.values, labels=age_sales.index, autopct='%1.1f%%',
                                    startangle=90, colors=plt.cm.Pastel1(np.arange(len(age_sales))/len(age_sales)))
ax3.set_title('Sales Distribution by Age Group', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
for autotext in autotexts:
    autotext.set_color('black')
    autotext.set_fontweight('bold')

# 4. Takeaway vs Dine-in comparison (bottom left)
ax4 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 4)
takeaway_data = df.groupby('is_takeaway').agg({'total': 'sum', 'quantity': 'sum'})
takeaway_labels = ['Dine-in', 'Takeaway']
x_pos = np.arange(len(takeaway_labels))
width = 0.35

bars1 = ax4.bar(x_pos - width/2, takeaway_data['total'], width, label='Total Sales ($)', color='skyblue')
bars2 = ax4.bar(x_pos + width/2, takeaway_data['quantity'], width, label='Quantity Sold', color='lightcoral')

ax4.set_xlabel('Service Type')
ax4.set_ylabel('Values')
ax4.set_title('Takeaway vs Dine-in Performance', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_xticks(x_pos)
ax4.set_xticklabels(takeaway_labels)
ax4.legend()
ax4.grid(True, alpha=0.3, axis='y')

# 5. Payment method distribution (bottom middle)
ax5 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 5)
payment_counts = df['payment_method'].value_counts()
colors = plt.cm.Set2(np.arange(len(payment_counts))/len(payment_counts))
bars = ax5.barh(range(len(payment_counts)), payment_counts.values, color=colors)
ax5.set_yticks(range(len(payment_counts)))
ax5.set_yticklabels(payment_counts.index)
ax5.set_xlabel('Number of Transactions')
ax5.set_title('Payment Method Distribution', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax5.grid(True, alpha=0.3, axis='x')

# Add count labels to bars
for i, (bar, count) in enumerate(zip(bars, payment_counts.values)):
    ax5.text(bar.get_width() + max(payment_counts.values)*0.01, bar.get_y() + bar.get_height()/2,
             f'{count}', va='center', fontweight='bold')

# 6. Size preference by product (bottom right)
ax6 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 6)
size_product = pd.crosstab(df['product'], df['size'], normalize='index') * 100
size_product = size_product.reindex(product_sales.index[:5])  # Top 5 products
size_product.plot(kind='bar', stacked=True, ax=ax6, width=0.8)
ax6.set_xlabel('Product')
ax6.set_ylabel('Percentage (%)')
ax6.set_title('Size Preference by Product (Top 5)', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax6.legend(title='Size', bbox_to_anchor=(1.05, 1), loc='upper left')
ax6.set_xticklabels(ax6.get_xticklabels(), rotation=45, ha='right')
ax6.grid(True, alpha=0.3, axis='y')

# Adjust layout and save
plt.suptitle('Coffee Shop Sales Analysis Dashboard', fontsize=18, fontweight='bold', y=0.98)
plt.tight_layout(rect=[0, 0, 1, 0.96])
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150, facecolor='white')
plt.close()
